svg.text: Never delete the agent's local queue or database to clear an error

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It destroys unsent audit-trail events, which is a data-integrity incident. Work outward instead: service running, connection entry present, port

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: reachable, then registration; reinstalling is the last resort.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Time must be domain-synchronized (w32tm /query /status) before any of this: audit-trail timestamps depend on it. Controls: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e) audit trails; ALCOA+ Attributable and Contemporaneous.
